strongest_thesis.text: UAA's new EEG expands students' control over data collection, letting an AI research question shape the recording they make.
strongest_thesis.reason: This is the largest meaningful claim already earned by the acquisition, training and student's account. It gives Alaska a concrete gain and makes the two planned tasks relevant without treating either as completed research. It also remains useful if the eventual experiment studies within-person change rather than generalization to strangers.

cross_challenges.strongest_feature: A clear causal change from available public recordings to deliberately designed local collection, with a deserved celebratory tone.
cross_challenges.precise_challenge: The Act 3 line calling a moving trace an already-useful answer the strongest opposing claim supplies a straw opponent. Nobody in the safe set makes that claim. Your actual fair counterpoint about public datasets already enabling useful work is stronger.
cross_challenges.refinement: Let existing public-data research stand as the fair case, then show what a new chosen task adds. Use the distinction between recording and interpretation to move forward, without staging an unnamed booster who thinks the trace proves an answer.

cross_challenges.strongest_feature: The arrival of a person absent from training is a concrete second movement with an evidence-backed consequence. It can turn an abstract evaluation principle into a comprehensible question.
cross_challenges.precise_challenge: The thesis calls new-person testing the strongest use of this equipment before either study's intended use is known. Valid EEG research can examine change within the same individual. Equal mixed-person and held-out-person scores would also challenge an expected inflation effect, not falsify the need to match evaluation to the claim.
cross_challenges.refinement: Keep the new-person test conditional and subordinate to the acquired-capability story. Say 'If the claim is that a model works for new people, test people it hasn't trained on.' Give the new person an open test, not a failed score or an accusation about UAA.

recommended_synthesis: Use proposal 2's acquired-control thesis and celebratory register. Borrow proposal 3's new-person arrival only as a conditional Act 3 example of the better experiments that control enables. Close on a choice of research question.
one_priority_refinement: Replace the implied universal generalization requirement with an explicit condition tied to what the eventual model claims to do.
format_judgment: One capability gain, two brief planned applications and one conditional test fit the 200 to 220 word narration. A detailed discussion of leakage, split types or old clinical datasets would displace the Alaska story.
